prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop website design comp for UNION3D, a Brazilian reality capture and dimensional documentation company serving construction teams and architects in Santa Catarina. Render the interface edge to edge, crisp readable Portuguese text, landscape canvas about 1536 by 1024, no browser frame or device mockup. Show a finished first viewport plus a meaningful intermediate section, not a poster. The visual world is an architectural construction record: off-white dominant ground, institutional deep ink #002E40, confident distinctive sans-serif typography, controlled asymmetry, generous margins and precise editorial alignment. No gradients, neon, rounded cards, dashboards or decorative grids. Header: provisional typeset UNION3D, links Serviços, Sobre, Aplicações, Contato. Hero leads with 'Antes de decidir, registre o que existe.' and a concise description: 'Escaneamento a laser 3D, levantamentos e conferências para orientar projetos e obras.' Visible actions: 'Solicitar orçamento' and 'Explorar serviços'. The dominant image is a wide, beautifully lit unfinished concrete building, a conceptual architectural study transitioning quietly on one side into a geometric point-cloud representation of the SAME structure. Build the hero as an offset editorial title band followed by expansive architecture, not a standard text-left image-right split. Label the image 'Estudo visual conceitual — não representa obra da UNION3D'. Below, show the intermediate section 'A obra avança. O acesso muda.' as a readable horizontal sequence Fundações / Estrutura / Instalações / Intervenção with understated state images and short service labels. Keep these stages clearly secondary to the main image. The page should communicate technical trust and offer clear navigation without invented clients, statistics, testimonials or specifications.
description: Estudo A — Registro em sequência. Arquitetura e nuvem de pontos geradas; não são trabalho da UNION3D.
